race.title: INHSC Supporting Point-To-Points Hunters Chase
race.verdict: MY LIFE BE LIKE made the frame in a strong hunter chase on Boxing Day last year and that looks the piece of form to concentrate on. Everest The Brave is unexposed and rates a big danger, while Hearts And Spades can't be ignored. MY LIFE BE LIKE (IRE) EVEREST THE BRAVE (IRE) HEARTS AND SPADES (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Hearts And Spades (2/1), My Life Be Like (3/1), Everest The Brave (4/1), Bartlemy Boy (10/1), Gale Force Jet (10/1), Grageen (14/1), Big Interest (16/1), Cold Old Fire (16/1), Yewtree Hill (20/1), Bower House Boy (25/1)
